description: The article proposes modelling educational tests as partially specified structural causal models in which observable endogenous variables (answers and hint usage) are generated by latent exogenous variables.
title: Partially specified structural causal model (PSCM) protocol for educational assessment

description: Pathfinder is a graph-theoretic distance technique that represents a proximity matrix in a graphical network structure (PFnet).
title: Pathfinder network technique for structural assessment

description: The framework defines knowledge components as \"recurring, semantically meaningful structural patterns based on important subtrees from program Abstract Syntax Trees (ASTs)\".
title: Pattern-based knowledge component extraction from program ASTs
